description: Update app metadata, store destination, timezone or coverage mode.

bundle_id.description: New iOS bundle id or Android package name, 3 to 255 characters. Omit to keep the current one.

device_matching_mode.description: New coverage mode. on: maximum coverage, events of all eligible matches are sent. strict: events of verified matches only. Omit to keep the current one.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact mutation.

name.description: New app name, 1 to 80 characters. Omit to keep the current one.

platform.description: New platform, iOS or Android. Omit to keep the current one.

store_url.description: New App Store or Google Play page URL. Omit to keep the current one.

timezone.description: New app timezone, at most 64 characters. Omit to keep the current one.

name: update_app
title: Update an app
